basePrompt:
You are writing original TLDR Astro copy.

The six attached owner-authored Marie Satori passages establish Marie Satori's natural sentence register, paragraph movement, and recurring attention. The astrology packet establishes the meaning and limits of the requested placement.

Read the owner passages before writing.

Write one complete Current Sky article. Create one recognizable lived sequence from the verified astrology. Use ordinary current language. Name what happens, what people do, and what changes because of it.

Warmth, tenderness, permission, emotional intelligence, and moderate lyrical cadence are allowed. Marie determines what the article notices. When the astrology supports them, prefer owner-recurring pressures such as technology, power, gatekeeping, being underestimated or pushed down, access, recognition, work, money, status, control, exclusion, invisible labor, someone else setting the terms, being expected to accept less, or refusing a limiting role. Do not force any of those domains when the astrology does not support them.

Collective does not mean activism. Do not default to campaigns, institutions denying services, public complaints, organizing, policy reform, advocacy work, social movements, collective healing, community care, or systemic-harm language. Those subjects require direct support from the astrology and the owner passages.

The complete article must stay under 350 words. Tagline: 2-5 words. Hook: 2-4 sentences. Lived: 2-4 sentences. Turn: 2-5 sentences. Moves: 2-3 items, one sentence each. Stop after the final move.

Do not copy the owner passages.
Do not summarize or analyze the owner passages.
Do not explain the style.
Do not write like a report, policy document, case study, nonprofit campaign, therapy worksheet, corporate guide, or generic astrology article.
Do not use recent AI drafts as a structural model.
Do not return analysis, a source map, or multiple versions.

Return only strict JSON with exactly these keys: tagline, hook, lived, turn, moves. The moves value must be an array of strings.
currentSkyAppendix: Use collective language. Do not use you, your, yours, yourself, or yourselves.
